title: IJP German-Northern European Programme
description: A journalist exchange fellowship run by IJP (Internationale Journalisten-Programme), open to working print, radio, and TV journalists -- staff or freelance -- aged 18 to 45 from Denmark, Iceland, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. The 2026 programme opens with a multi-day introductory meeting in a Nordic capital or Berlin, followed by a six- to eight-week placement at a German host media outlet chosen by IJP based on each participant's interests and preferences. Each fellow receives a single stipend payment of EUR 3,800 intended to cover travel, accommodation, and living costs during the exchange; it is a lump sum rather than separately booked flights or lodging, so participants arrange and manage their own travel and housing with it. Only a workable knowledge of English is required, not German. Applicants submit a CV with photo, a letter of recommendation from an editor, and four writing samples (or a broadcast contributions list for TV/radio journalists). Application deadline for the 2026 cohort is August 1, 2026.
visaNote: This is a short-term journalist exchange placement, not local employment; participants from Nordic/Baltic EU and EEA countries typically do not need a separate work visa for a stay of this length in Germany.
